learning_outcomes.text: He/She can investigate the rectilinear and plane curvilinear motion of particles.
He/She can realize the concepts of force, mass and acceleration.
He/She can realize the concepts of work-energy principles, conservation of energy, power and effeciency.
He/She can learn application of impuls-momentum methods.
He/She can realize the kinematics of rigid bodies and motion types.Realization of velocity and accelaration analysis.
He/She can realize the forces and accelerations of rigid bodies.
He/She can realize the energy and momentum methods of plane motion of rigid bodies.

syllabus_topics: Kinetics of particles: Force and acceleration.
Kinetics of particles: Work and energy.
Kinetics of particles: Impuls and momentum.
Plane kinetics of rigid bodies:Force and acceleration.
Plane kinetics of rigid bodies:Work and energy
Plane kinetics of rigid bodies:Impuls and momentum
